title: quartifyr render result
description: What `Rscript inst/scripts/render.R --json` prints on stdout, and the fields of render_report()'s return value. `status` describes whether the delivered document is complete: "error" means unfilled placeholders or a failed requested post-processing step (or, for a render that stopped early, the error in `errors`); "warning" means complete but flagged (e.g. a missing metadata sidecar); "ok" means nothing to report. Version 1 of the shape: new optional fields may be added without changing the version (consumers should ignore fields they do not know); removing or renaming a field, or changing its meaning, publishes render-result-v2.schema.json and bumps `schema_version`.

status.description: Under --strict, an incomplete render is always "error".

shell.description: Path to the rendered shell docx.

draft.description: Path to the draft docx filled by reportifyr.

final.description: Path to the final docx; null unless status was final.

artifacts.description: The files that exist, with SHA-256 hashes.

unfilled_placeholders.description: {rpfy}: magic strings still present in the draft/final docx.

missing_metadata.description: Artifacts referenced by the shell that have no metadata sidecar.

log_dir.description: reportifyr's log directory for the project.

error_class.description: Only present on failure: the R condition class, e.g. quartifyr_quarto_timeout, quartifyr_render_incomplete.

inputs.description: The files the render read (only those that exist), with SHA-256 hashes. Absent on a render that stopped early.

versions.description: Tool versions; null where one could not be determined. Absent on a render that stopped early.

libreoffice.description: The LibreOffice that ran the --recalculate-fields / --resolve-same-page-crossrefs steps: its resolved path and `soffice --version` line. null when neither step was requested or LibreOffice could not be found.

started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the render began.

finished_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the render ended.
